# ExoClick

> ExoClick is a global ad tech company and the world's largest digital advertising platform in the entertainment sector, operating both an Ad Network and an Ad Exchange for Advertisers and Publishers.

ExoClick (https://www.exoclick.com/) is an ad tech company founded in 2006 by Benjamin Fonzé, part of EXOGROUP (https://www.exogroup.com/). Legal entity: EXOCLICK, S.L., Barcelona, Spain.

## Key facts

- Founded in 2006 in Barcelona, Spain
- Over 20 billion geo-targeted ads served per day
- 65,000 web and mobile publisher platforms
- 19 ad formats
- Over 100 employees of more than 25 nationalities

## Main pages

- [About Us](https://www.exoclick.com/about-us/): ExoClick is a global ad tech company founded in 2006, serving 20 billion daily geo-targeted ads across 65,000 publisher platforms worldwide.
- [Ad Formats](https://www.exoclick.com/ad-formats/): ExoClick offers 19 ad formats for desktop and mobile: Display, Video, Native, Push Notifications, Popunders, Vertical Video, Email Clicks and more.
- [Advertiser Guidelines](https://www.exoclick.com/guidelines/advertisers/): Read ExoClick's Advertiser guidelines covering campaign approval rules, ad format requirements, compliance and policies.
- [AI-Powered Ad Platform](https://www.exoclick.com/ai/): ExoClick's AI-powered tools automate campaign bidding, optimize performance in real time and connect your account to external AI workflows via MCP Server.
- [Become a Publisher](https://www.exoclick.com/publishers/): Monetize your website, email lists, members area or SSP inventory with ExoClick. 100% fill rate, thousands of active advertiser campaigns, on-time payments.
- [Become an Advertiser](https://www.exoclick.com/advertisers/): Reach billions of daily ad opportunities across 19 formats with deep targeting, AI-powered bidding and self-serve, managed or programmatic buying.
- [Contact Us](https://www.exoclick.com/contact/): Have a question about advertising or publishing with ExoClick? Ask our docs assistant, browse the documentation or contact our team. We are available 24/7.
- [ExoClick Ethical Channel](https://www.exoclick.com/ethical-channel/): ExoClick's Ethical Channel allows anyone to report irregularities or behaviors that violate the law or our values, anonymously and confidentially.
- [ExoClick Academy](https://www.exoclick.com/academy/): Free video courses with certificates for ExoClick advertisers and publishers, from basic to advanced level. Learn at your own pace, on any device.
- [Publisher Guidelines](https://www.exoclick.com/guidelines/publishers/): Read ExoClick's Publisher guidelines covering website approval rules, DSA compliance, content policies and payment terms.
- [Transparency & Consent Framework](https://www.exoclick.com/tcf/): How the IAB Europe TCF works with ExoClick: the consent pop-up shown to end users, Personalized and Limited Ads, and what it means for Publishers and Advertisers.
- [Trust & Safety](https://www.exoclick.com/trust-and-safety/): ExoClick operates a 24/7 Compliance Team to protect publishers, advertisers and end users from malvertising, illegal content and online harm.

## Documentation and learning

- [ExoClick Documentation](https://docs.exoclick.com/)
- [ExoClick Academy](https://www.exoclick.com/academy/)

## Latest articles

- [ExoClick’s MCP Server: Are you ready to revolutionize your AI workflow?](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/exoclick-mcp-server/) (2026-11-25): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI agents to your ExoClick account with the MCP Server, and manage campaigns and ad zones in plain language.
- [Retargeting Case Study: Dating](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/retargeting-case-study-dating/) (2026-11-17): How Adsomnia's media buyers used ExoClick's Pixel and S2S Retargeting on Dating offers to earn almost $21k in extra revenue, with up to 500%+ ROI.
- [ExoClick is attending Affiliate World Asia, Bangkok](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/exoclick-attends-affiliate-world-asia-bangkok/) (2026-11-16): Meet ExoClick's Customer Success Team at Affiliate World Asia in Bangkok, December 9–10, 2026, at Booth 06. Book your meeting here!
- [Ad tech in 2027: AI trends for Advertisers and Publishers](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/ai-trends-for-advertisers-and-publishers/) (2026-11-09): ExoClick leaders predict 2027 shifts in agentic Media Buyer tools, RTB supply path optimization, and vertical Native feed monetization.
- [Black Friday 2026: Strategies for eCommerce Advertisers](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/black-friday-2026/) (2026-11-03): Discover Black Friday 2026 trends, top categories, and high-converting Native and Banners strategies to maximize your Advertiser revenue.
- [Women in ad tech: Leadership and Customer Success](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/women-in-ad-tech-leadership-and-customer-success/) (2026-10-26): Learn how adaptability, mentorship, and Customer Success help women advance into leadership roles at ExoClick and across ad tech.
- [Publisher Case Studies: Monetizing with Vertical Video](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/vertical-video-case-study/) (2026-10-22): Discover in this Vertical Video Case Study how 3 publishers monetize vertical video feeds to boost ad revenue and site yield.
- [Sports Betting Events Q4 2026!](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/sports-betting-events-q4-2026/) (2026-10-19): The final quarter of 2026 is here. Check out the biggest betting events in October, November, and December 2026.
- [Mastering Halloween Campaigns: Creatives & Seasonal Strategies](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/mastering-halloween-advertising-creatives/) (2026-10-08): Maximize your Q4 campaign ROI this Halloween: use AI to build festive, high-converting creatives for dating, gaming and more.
- [ExoClick has a new brand identity](https://www.exoclick.com/blog/exoclick-has-a-new-brand-identity/) (2026-09-25): ExoClick is this year celebrating its 20th anniversary. To mark this occasion ExoClick has rebranded with a new logo and redesigned website.

## Legal

- [Cookies Policy](https://www.exoclick.com/cookies-policy/)
- [We take Copyright Infringement seriously](https://www.exoclick.com/copyright-infringement/)

- [EU DSA Transparency Report 2024](https://www.exoclick.com/dsa/transparency-report-2024/)
- [EU DSA Transparency Report 2025](https://www.exoclick.com/dsa/transparency-report-2025/)
- [EU User Consent Policy](https://www.exoclick.com/eu-user-consent-policy/)
- [GDPR Overview and Guidance](https://www.exoclick.com/gdpr-overview-and-guidance/)
- [Legal Notice](https://www.exoclick.com/legal-notice/)
- [Política de Privacidad](https://www.exoclick.com/es/privacy-policy/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.exoclick.com/privacy-policy/)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.exoclick.com/terms-and-conditions/)
